modules.name: simulation.py
modules.role: Master simulation loop, turn orchestrator, weekly event trigger, and termination evaluator.

modules.name: world.py
modules.role: Manages 25x25 2D Tile matrix, terrain generation, resource spawning, and spatial neighbor queries.

modules.name: animal.py
modules.role: Encapsulates status vitals (Health, Hunger, Thirst, Energy, Instinct), traits, inventory, and action execution.

modules.name: neural_net.py
modules.role: Implements the 41-16-12-8 Multi-Layer Perceptron forward propagation, weight flattening, and mutation routines.

modules.name: genetic_algorithm.py
modules.role: Handles population fitness scoring, elitism extraction, tournament selection, crossover recombination, and generational replacement.

modules.name: events.py
modules.role: Generates localized hazards, scheduled weekly disasters (Wildfire, Blizzard, Flood), and manages dice check resolution.

modules.name: gui.py
modules.role: Pygame/Tkinter visualization rendering the live 25x25 grid, animal positions, health bars, and generational telemetry.

guidelines: All magic numbers must strictly reference constants from config.py to maintain mathematical consistency.
Decisions made by the MLP must be completely deterministic given identical weight matrices and sensory inputs.
State modifications to animal vitals must be bounded using clamping functions (e.g. min 0, max MaxHealth).
Combat checks resolve in constant time O(1) with zero circular dependency between rival agents.
